source:
@@U03740@@
But here they come,
the little beauties,
and what are they carrying?
Steps to the throne,
carpet and seat,
curtain and canopy
richly embroidered,
wave upon wave,
like cloudy wreaths,
it flows on high
over the queenly head,
for already invited,
she has mounted the throne’s
cushioned seat.
Come! Move forward!
Range yourselves
in rows on each step.
Worthy, worthy, oh three-times worthy
the dignity of so blest a reception!
(Everything described by the CHORUS occurs in sequence. After the long
procession of PAGES and SQUIRES has descended, 浮士德, dressed as
a medieval courtier, appears at the head of the stairs and comes down
with slow dignity.)

@@U03742@@
(Observing him attentively.)

@@U03743@@
Unless the gods, as so often they do,
have lent this man for a short time only
his admirable figure,
his stately bearing,
and loving presence,
then he will succeed in all he undertakes,
whether battles of men or that lesser skirmish
with the loveliest women.
I have seen other men most highly esteemed,
but there can be no question that he takes preference.
I see the Prince approach her now,
solemnly, with slow reverent step.
Turn now, great Queen, and face him!
translation:
@@U03740@@
但他们来了，
小美女们，
他们携带什么？
迈向王座，
地毯和座椅，
窗帘和天篷
绣得很丰富，
一波又一波，
像云朵一样的花环，
它在高处流动
在女王的头上，
对于已经受邀的，
她已经登上了王位
带软垫的座椅。
来！前进！
调整自己的范围
每一步都成行。
值得，值得，哦，三倍值得
如此有福的接待的尊严！
（合唱所描述的一切都是按顺序发生的。在漫长的
侍从和侍从的队伍已经降临，浮士德，打扮成
一位中世纪朝臣出现在楼梯口并下来
带着缓慢的尊严。）

@@U03742@@
（仔细观察他。）

@@U03743@@
除非众神像他们经常做的那样，
只借给这个人一段时间
他令人钦佩的身材，
他的威严举止，
和爱的存在，
那么他所做的一切都会成功，
无论是人类的战斗还是较小的小冲突
与最可爱的女人。
我见过其他最受尊敬的人，
但毫无疑问他会优先考虑。
我现在看到王子走近她，
庄严地，缓慢而虔诚地迈着步伐。
现在转身，伟大的女王，面对他！
